name: Mastery Mat 4mm
description: An everyday yoga mat designed for stability, durability, and reliable grip — even during sweaty sessions — giving you confidence in every pose and reliable support for your joints. Built to stay grounded through intense or slow practices alike, it helps you move without distraction, maintain better alignment, and enjoy a calm, focused practice that lasts for years.

productPageSections.heading: Specs & Care
items: Dimension: 183cm long x 68cm wide x 4mm thick (2.7kg)
Materials: SGS-certified natural rubber, non-toxic vegan leather
Care:
Gently wipe the mat with a damp cloth after each use
Do not use oil-based cleaning products
Air dry the mat before rolling
Store out of direct sunlight and heat source
Roll with top of mat side facing out, rolling in opposite direction can damage mat surface
